commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0f74cf44d4c4971b1ccb18fd29a7612fb955cb31"; test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-130; python3 - <<'PY'
import time
import serial
port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-130'
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.25, write_timeout=2) as ser:
    time.sleep(2.0)
    ser.reset_input_buffer()
    ser.write(b'G28 Z\n')
    ser.flush()
    print('SENT:G28 Z', flush=True)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 90.0
    saw_ok = False
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if not raw:
            continue
        text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').strip()
        if text:
            print(f'RX:{text}', flush=True)
        lower = text.lower()
        if lower.startswith('error') or 'printer halted' in lower or 'kill() called' in lower:
            raise SystemExit(f'printer error: {text}')
        if lower == 'ok' or lower.startswith('ok '):
            saw_ok = True
            break
    if not saw_ok:
        raise SystemExit('timeout waiting for final ok after G28 Z')
print('RESULT:Z_HOME_OK')
PY
